project_info.theme: Sensitive-skin combo poster with soft towel-styled set
project_info.color_palette: Warm Beige, Pastel Pink, Soft Yellow, Powder Blue, White, Rose Pink

main_subject.detail: A cozy styled product poster showing Hau Giang lotus toner, Hau Giang lotus cleanser, and Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid arranged among plush towels, with a large claim about cleansing, recovery, and high protection for ultra-sensitive skin plus a pink discount circle reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 46%'.
main_subject.style: Soft lifestyle merchandising, clean skincare still life, warm tactile retail poster

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'LÀM SẠCH, PHỤC HỒI, BẢO VỆ CAO CHO DA RẤT NHẠY CẢM' and 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 46%'. Product labels for toner, cleanser, and mineral sun fluid are visible.
items: Top Left: Large cream headline stacked over a textured beige wall.
Top Right: Bright pink circular badge reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 46%'.
Bottom Left: Pink Hau Giang lotus toner bottle leaning diagonally over a peach towel.
Bottom Right: White Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid bottle upright beside blue and cream towels.
Center/Background: Pink pump cleanser bottle standing vertically in front of striped yellow towel props.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Cozy towel texture, gentle shadows, tactile skincare warmth, premium sensitive-skin calm

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity styled skincare product photography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a sensitive-skin skincare combo. Centerpiece is a warm towel-styled arrangement of Cocoon Hau Giang lotus toner, cleanser, and mineral sun fluid, framed by plush pastel towels. Background is a textured beige wall. Surrounding elements: large claim 'LÀM SẠCH, PHỤC HỒI, BẢO VỆ CAO CHO DA RẤT NHẠY CẢM', a pink badge 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 46%', and visible product labels. Keep the cozy tactile styling, diagonal toner bottle, and upright sunscreen bottle in the front-right. Technical style: high fidelity styled skincare product photography, warm soft studio lighting, cozy towel texture and gentle shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
